title: Raising Bidders' Awareness in Second-Price Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2412.12676v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When bidders bid on complex objects, they might be unaware of characteristics affecting their valuations. We assume that each buyer's valuation is a sum of independent random variables, one for each characteristic. When a bidder is unaware of a characteristic, he omits the random variable from the sum. We study the seller's decision to raise bidders' awareness of characteristics before a second-price auction with entry fees. Optimal entry fees capture an additional unawareness rent due to unaware bidders misperceiving their probability of winning and the price to be paid upon winning. When raising a bidder's individual awareness of a characteristic with positive expected value, the seller faces a trade-off between positive effects on the expected first order statistic and unawareness rents of remaining unaware bidders on one hand and the loss of the unawareness rent from the newly aware bidder on the other. translated_title: 提高二级价格拍卖中竞标者的认知水平
translated_abstract: 当竞标者对复杂物品进行竞拍时，他们可能并不知晓某些影响自身估值的特征。我们假设每个买方的估值是独立随机变量之和，每个特征对应一个随机变量。当竞标者不知晓某个特征时，他会把该随机变量从总和中省略。我们研究了卖方在收取入场费的二级价格拍卖之前提高竞标者对特征认知水平的决策。最优入场费能够捕获由不知情竞标者误判自身获胜概率及获胜后所需支付价格而产生的额外“不知情租金”。当卖方提高竞标者对某一具有正期望值特征的个体认知时，卖方面临一个权衡：一方面是对期望一阶统计量的正面影响以及剩余不知情竞标者不知情租金的影响，另一方面是新近获知信息竞标者不知情租金的损失。我们提出了关于提升认知水平的相关结果……
tldr: 本文研究了在收取入场费的二级价格拍卖中，卖方是否应提高竞标者对影响估值特征的认知，揭示了最优入场费如何捕获不知情租金，以及提升认知时收益与租金损失之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper studies a seller's decision to raise bidders' awareness of valuation-relevant characteristics before a second-price auction with entry fees, showing how optimal entry fees capture unawareness rents and identifying the trade-off between the benefits of awareness and the loss of those rents.
